Description.value: Breaks the lock-order inversion between MultiBlockManager.lockObj and RegionFileManager.chunksInSaveDir that freezes the whole server while MaxChunkAge chunk reset is enabled. MultiBlockManager.OnChunkInitialized and RegionFileManager.AddGroupedChunks acquire their lock non-blocking; on contention the work is queued and replayed on the main thread from MultiBlockManager.MainThreadUpdate instead of being dropped, so chunk reset keeps its full behaviour. MultiBlockManager.CullChunklessData is made non-blocking and resetVolumeDataForChunks is deferred to the main thread. Every patch on the chunk save path falls back to vanilla behaviour instead of propagating, so a mod fault can never abort DoSaveChunks. Logs every chunk reset with count and world coordinates, and runs a main thread watchdog that warns on a 45s stall and triggers a managed stack dump of all threads via SIGQUIT at 90s. Serializes RegionFileV2.OptimizeLayout under the region file lock, which game version 2.6 omits and 3.2 has, so layout optimization can no longer rebuild usedSectors while a concurrent WriteData allocates from it. The sector allocator ignores reserved sector entries and can never return a sector below 3, and a stale location entry pointing into the reserved sectors is dropped and reallocated instead of overwriting the file header. Region file protection is a precondition: if those members are missing, no patch is applied at all. Deferred grouping now takes saveLock before chunksInSaveDir, matching the lock order the game asserts. OptimizeLayout additionally takes a process-wide gate because optimizerMemoryStream is static and shared by every region file, which the instance lock does not cover. The world's single shared chunk read and write buffers are serialized: ChunkSnapshotUtil.LoadChunk runs under a reader gate covering readStream, zipLoadStream, loadChunkMemoryStream, loadBuffer, magicBytes and WriteBackup, and RegionFileChunkWriter.WriteStreamCompressed runs under a writer gate. The engine leaves these unsynchronized in both 2.6 and 3.2, and two concurrent chunk loads tear the stream and make LoadChunk delete a healthy chunk without checking land claim protection. A failed read is retried once under the gate and recovers the chunk instead of losing it, and the delete-on-read-failure path is refused so chunk data stays on disk. Built for game version 2.6.
